referenceMethod: Zachary's September 11 final goal reconciled against reviewed PR #319 source and exact-head hosted evidence

surfaces.implementedScope: Persistent/Temporary chats, streaming/stop, edit/retry/regenerate/branch, rich rendering, search/pins/archive/restore and explicit cloud-history migration.
surfaces.boundary: Explicit saveable/personalized Temporary Chat behavior, live model/provider use, authenticated persistence and production smoke remain unverified.

surfaces.implementedScope: Drafts, keyboard/paste/drop, formatted paste and large-paste attachments; PDF/Office extraction, images and explicit Library reuse.
surfaces.boundary: Supported parsers and size/type limits apply. No audio/video transcription, recording or arbitrary media ingestion claim.

surfaces.implementedScope: Current Kova mode catalog, exact server plan/model access and Work reasoning choices from signed provider capabilities.
surfaces.boundary: Astra-class premium capability is required but is not an authorized automatic model migration or a proven deployment. Capability discovery, eval gates, quotas, latency and live Azure availability remain.

surfaces.area: Search, images, shopping and local discovery
surfaces.implementedScope: Existing sourced web search; Discovery package adds bounded Firecrawl web/image metadata, explicit merchant verification/variant comparison and explicit-place handoffs.
surfaces.boundary: Discovery is pending integration in this snapshot. Merchant facts need successful source checks; unknown price/stock stays unknown. No location tracking, native map, live booking or reverse-image claim.

surfaces.implementedScope: Source preferences, research plan, bounded live search/synthesis, progress/cancel, persisted evidence/report and exports with current authorization.
surfaces.boundary: Provider-native paused/resumable runs and live redirection are not exposed by the current configured adapter. A provider contract is needed before promising those semantics; existing partial results are not a resumed provider run.

surfaces.implementedScope: One isolated Work runner, typed API/text browser, interactive semantic browser with owner takeover, Python and fixed no-shell terminal commands, exact approvals and cancellation recovery.
surfaces.boundary: New specialist delegation remains an autonomous source gap. Browser uses ephemeral private sessions and reviewed HTTPS origins, not a desktop profile or arbitrary OS control. Real runsc/container acceptance is a hosted gate.

surfaces.implementedScope: Shared Chat/Work admission, saved session revision binding, queued direction edits, questions, one-use approvals, durable recovery/accounting, notifications and real PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX outputs.
surfaces.boundary: Work-to-Site output publication and new specialist runs remain source gaps. Current completion accepts Library outputs only; standalone Sites is not evidence of Work publication. Admission stays off without signed runner readiness.

surfaces.implementedScope: CRUD, pause/resume/history, anchored timezone/DST recurrence, conditions, verified native Gmail/Slack/GitHub event ingress, saved/connected context and recipient-authorized copies.
surfaces.boundary: Shareable/customizable copies, exact free/paid limits, safe browser tasks, runtime heartbeat, current OAuth access, live callbacks, provider budgets and notification delivery remain.

surfaces.implementedScope: Project lifecycle, files/instructions/memory/chats, current member roles, revision-aware comments/presence, templates and explicit sharing.
surfaces.boundary: Project retention policy/execution is pending source. Live Realtime publication, two-account permissions and storage cleanup require matching deployment evidence. Presence is not CRDT editing.

surfaces.implementedScope: Original files, nested folders, bulk organization, lazy private images, keyset search, on-demand bodies, immutable versions, replacement/revert and storage accounting.
surfaces.boundary: Temporary Chat never auto-saves. Current text/version/original-byte limits and exact Storage provenance apply. Image-byte quota follow-up is tracked separately until included in the audited tree.

surfaces.implementedScope: Generate/view/download and principal-scoped IndexedDB history; private Library source edits with optional dimension-matched alpha PNG masks and source-digest metadata.
surfaces.boundary: Flare-class and Sunburst-class routing, visible quality/cost choices, advanced edit acceptance, provenance, live provider capabilities and cross-category settlement remain.

surfaces.implementedScope: Saved memory controls, prompt-source inspection, scoped preferences, current-source authorization, themes/language and bounded semantic workspace retrieval.
surfaces.boundary: Search considers bounded accessible records/snippets; it is not an unlimited whole-document index. Semantic fallback labels the mode used. Native Computer History and proprietary ranking are outside web scope.

surfaces.implementedScope: Immutable Custom Kova instructions/knowledge versions, builder/preview, private/link/public directory, fork, bounded moderation and current caller tool/model access.
surfaces.boundary: Complete store governance, publish/share/install/update/archive analytics, verified publishers, organization distribution, live moderation operations and production canaries remain.

surfaces.implementedScope: Connector directory, OAuth custody/scopes, multi-account Google generation binding, current-access checks, confirmed writes, sync/index adapters, and owner-scoped immutable workflow skill installation/resolution.
surfaces.boundary: WebMCP and complete provider-neutral discovery remain unfinished. Catalog visibility is not operational support; each provider/account still needs consent, revocation, live credentials and acceptance.

surfaces.implementedScope: Bounded document extraction, CSV analysis/charts and actual Python/file execution in networkless runsc containers; fixed terminal operations and verified output bytes.
surfaces.boundary: No arbitrary host shell, package installation, host filesystem/network access or unlimited notebook environment. Deploy pinned sandbox image/runtime and pass real hosted container acceptance.

surfaces.implementedScope: Writing/code full-screen editor, selection edits, durable revisions/compare/comments, isolated HTML preview, chart rendering and document exports.
surfaces.boundary: Export writers support declared formats; they do not establish lossless arbitrary Office-template editing. Interactive HTML is sandboxed; no untrusted preview gets app credentials or unrestricted network access.

surfaces.implementedScope: Immutable bounded static HTML/CSS/JS/assets, private/public publication, current-session access, stable isolated URLs/rename redirects, version lifecycle, erasure and bounded full export.
surfaces.boundary: Co-editing package is pending. Portable authenticated state and traffic analytics are recorded as additional public-reference differences for scope review, not requirements to clone OpenAI hosting. Arbitrary server code/OpenAI D1/R2 hosting is not claimed. Work import exists, but verified Work Site completion does not yet.

surfaces.implementedScope: Revocable chat snapshots, Project membership/templates, Canvas collaboration and owner-scoped chat/Work sync with outboxes, revisions, conflicts and reset fences.
surfaces.boundary: Shares remain snapshots, not live access to the sender account. Site editor grants are a separate pending package. Real cross-device/browser account verification remains a release gate.

surfaces.implementedScope: In-app unread/read/deep links plus preference-aware Work/Task notices; metadata-only Web Push with consent, quiet hours, timezone and current-principal delivery.
surfaces.boundary: Push defaults off and requires approved VAPID/worker configuration plus device permission. No universal SMS/email delivery or native background guarantee; only configured channels may claim delivery.

surfaces.implementedScope: Study depth/goals, quizzes/flashcards, hint/answer feedback, versioned practice progress, portable import/export and Temporary/guest controls.
surfaces.boundary: Scores report practice, not accredited assessment. Teaching/regulated school products, LMS integrations and institutional contracts are not implied.

surfaces.implementedScope: Verified targeted family/contact invitations, recipient consent/revocation, least-privilege settings, last-owner/erasure protections and bounded contact delivery policy.
surfaces.boundary: No parent chat surveillance or guaranteed emergency intervention. Age, regional/legal policy and actual delivery setup require owner decisions before activation.

surfaces.implementedScope: Auth/recovery/MFA/security controls, privacy settings, bounded asynchronous account export, durable deletion fence, storage-first retry and connector/runner cleanup.
surfaces.boundary: The private asynchronous cloud-account export backend exists. Production migration, worker scheduling, and multi-account verification remain required. Passkey availability follows the actual auth adapter; no unsupported passkey enrollment claim.

surfaces.implementedScope: Consumer checkout/portal/webhook entitlement and usage; developer exact quotes, reservations, settlement, prepaid funding and price administration with bounded financial retention.
surfaces.boundary: No source fixture proves live Stripe prices, quota, invoices, legal tax/retention policy or a purchasable enterprise entitlement. Owner-approved rates/funding and actual settlement canaries remain mandatory.

surfaces.area: Web, PWA, voice and native platforms
surfaces.implementedScope: Responsive web/PWA, install/share intake, offline public shell, supported push, owner-bound private-state clearing, and truthful required-but-unavailable voice metadata.
surfaces.boundary: Voice is required but unavailable. Full-duplex audio, interruption, transcripts, device/privacy controls, native applications and real physical-device permission/accessibility behavior remain.

surfaces.implementedScope: Scoped keys/projects, models/quotes, Responses/streaming/tools/structured outputs/images/embeddings/private text files, SDK, cost-bound MCP, browser S256 OAuth consent and revocation.
surfaces.boundary: Audio/realtime, agent/task/webhook breadth, real issuer/client registration, secrets, public billing activation, support/deprecation operations and production canaries remain.

surfaces.implementedScope: Organization owners/admins/members, targeted invitations, domains, SSO adapter, SCIM Users/Groups, current-member RLS, last-owner preflight, audit and deletion protections.
surfaces.boundary: Service accounts, analytics, complete connector/model/tool/spending policy, approved retention execution, live IdP/domain/legal setup, residency and production tenant tests remain.

surfaces.implementedScope: Workspace Timeline/Intelligence, Knowledge Graph, Prompt Studio, Context Packs, Goals/Kova Brain, Project health and authorized handoffs remain Kova-owned workflows.
surfaces.boundary: Relationships and health use stored authorized evidence. Local-only records are labeled. No invented intelligence, external data acquisition or model-generated relationship is treated as authoritative.
